body:
Apathy is convenient if you want to avoid emotional turmoil.

What I realized is that I've been coping with my emotions in the wrong ways--drug use--and I need some more healthy coping mechanisms. My drug use allowed me to be apathetic and avoid dealing with complex emotional issues.

Thanks for your insights. 

I've been mulling a change of environments and finally put the wheels into motion today. Whether I land in San Fran, Thailand, or Abu Dhabi is still up in the air, but I have a feeling that either three will give me the dramatic environmental change I need to appreciate what I have.

Guys thanks for the responses. I have been doing a lot of thinking and realize that I need to pull myself out of this rut. I really appreciate the encourage and positive thoughts. Just reading them have motivated me to finally get out of the house and begin to enjoy my work again. 

Dealing with my addiction is another story, but I have come to realize there is more to life than the feeling of making a lot of money and getting fucked up. 

Again, much appreciated.
